evidence.note: Credential is read from Extension.CurrentCredential(); when AuthenticationKind is UsernamePassword, UID and PWD are set in CredentialConnectionString.
Data source kind declares Authentication = [UsernamePassword = []] as its only auth kind.
Data is reached through Odbc.DataSource(ConnectionString, ...) using the MarkLogic SQL driver.
SqlCapabilities record is overridden (FractionalSecondsScale = 3) and passed to Odbc.DataSource.
SQLGetInfo record is overridden (SQL_SQL92_PREDICATES, SQL_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS, SQL_GROUP_BY, SQL_DATETIME_LITERALS, and SQL_CONVERT_WVARCHAR and related flags) and passed to Odbc.DataSource.

The user supplies server (hostname) and port (number). The server parameter names the connection target, so it is url-or-server. The port is not a resource, database, or option, so no other id applies.
Rows are returned as tables from the ODBC driver through Odbc.DataSource. No JSON, CSV, XML, or other parser is present.
SQLGetTypeInfo override supplies ODBC type metadata. This is driver metadata, not M type assignment to data columns.
SQLColumns override returns the driver's source table unchanged unless tracing is enabled, so column names and types stay driver-provided.
Transport is odbc, which is outside the web-contents and odata-feed applies_when set, so HTTP status handling does not apply.
Function-level Documentation.Name, LongDescription, and Examples are attached to the shared function type.
Server parameter has Documentation.FieldCaption, FieldDescription, and SampleValues.
Port parameter has Documentation.FieldCaption, FieldDescription, and SampleValues.
Odbc.DataSource lists tables from the driver at runtime, and HierarchicalNavigation = true groups them into schema folders.
TestConnection parses the JSON path and returns { "MarkLogicODBC.Contents", server, port }, reusing the entry function.
SqlCapabilities overrides are passed to Odbc.DataSource.
SQLGetInfo overrides, including SQL_SQL92_PREDICATES and SQL_DATETIME_LITERALS, shape folding through the ODBC driver.
AstVisitor LimitClause rewrites LIMIT/OFFSET inside the ODBC folding path, so it belongs under odbc-sql-capabilities.
Diagnostics.pqm and OdbcConstants.pqm are loaded through Extension.LoadFunction, so the code is split into .pqm modules.
Label and button text are loaded with Extension.LoadString.
Icons are loaded with Extension.Contents from PNG files.
The switch is set to false.
Diagnostics.LogValue is the real Trace-calling function only when EnableTraceOutput is true, otherwise it is a passthrough.
The SQLColumns override calls Diagnostics.LogValue only after an EnableTraceOutput check.
Diagnostics.Trace call, reached only through the EnableTraceOutput gate.
